title: Design System: Zara Desktop — Signal Cabin

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Decisive save, add, and new-chat actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 34px; padding: 0 13px; color: #0A1012; background: #61D095; border: 1px solid #61D095; border-radius: 9px; font: 600 14px "Adwaita Sans", sans-serif; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #7ADDA8; border-color: #7ADDA8; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #F2E9D8; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #61D095; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Native text field shared by conversation and settings forms.
components.css: .ds-input { min-height: 34px; padding: 9px 11px; color: #F2E9D8; background: #0D1518; border: 1px solid #2A393E; border-radius: 10px; font: 400 14px "Adwaita Sans", sans-serif; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #A8B7B3; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #3C5358; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #61D095; }

components.name: Settings Category Rail
components.description: Persistent task categories without preference cards.
components.css: .ds-settings-rail { display: grid; gap: 4px; width: 190px; padding: 18px 14px; color: #F2E9D8; background: #0D1518; border-right: 1px solid #2A393E; font: 400 14px "Adwaita Sans", sans-serif; } .ds-settings-rail strong { margin-bottom: 14px; font: 700 19px "Nimbus Sans Narrow", sans-serif; letter-spacing: 3px; } .ds-settings-rail button { padding: 10px 12px; color: #A8B7B3; background: transparent; border: none; border-radius: 9px; text-align: left; font: inherit; } .ds-settings-rail button:hover { color: #F2E9D8; background: #111A1E; } .ds-settings-rail button:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #61D095; } .ds-settings-rail button:active, .ds-settings-rail .ds-current { color: #F2E9D8; background: #17382B; }

components.name: Runtime Rail
components.description: Truthful runtime state shared by both conversation scales.
components.css: .ds-runtime { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 8px 12px; color: #F2E9D8; background: #111A1E; border: 1px solid #2A393E; border-radius: 10px; font: 400 14px "Adwaita Sans", sans-serif; } .ds-runtime:hover { border-color: #3C5358; } .ds-lamp { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 4px; background: #E7B84B; } .ds-runtime strong { color: #E7B84B; font: 700 11px "Hack Nerd Font Mono", monospace; letter-spacing: 1px; } .ds-runtime span:last-child { color: #A8B7B3; }

components.name: Unified Composer Action
components.description: The same platform-icon control sends at rest and stops while streaming.
components.css: .ds-composer-actions { display: flex; gap: 12px; background: #172226; padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #3C5358; border-radius: 15px; } .ds-composer-actions button { width: 38px; height: 38px; padding: 0; border-radius: 12px; display: grid; place-items: center; } .ds-composer-actions svg { width: 17px; height: 17px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; } .ds-composer-actions .ds-send { color: #0A1012; background: #61D095; border: 1px solid #61D095; } .ds-composer-actions .ds-send:hover { background: #7ADDA8; } .ds-composer-actions .ds-stop { color: #F2E9D8; background: #E6544D; border: 1px solid #E6544D; } .ds-composer-actions .ds-stop svg { fill: currentColor; stroke: none; } .ds-composer-actions .ds-stop:hover { background: #562727; } .ds-composer-actions button:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #F2E9D8; }

components.name: Theme Preview
components.description: A compact sample of one complete semantic palette.
components.css: .ds-theme-preview { width: 148px; height: 72px; padding: 9px 11px; color: #F2E9D8; background: #0A1012; border: 1px solid #3C5358; border-radius: 10px; text-align: left; font: 600 14px "Adwaita Sans", sans-serif; } .ds-theme-preview span { display: block; padding: 4px 8px; margin-bottom: 10px; background: #172226; border-radius: 6px; } .ds-theme-preview i { display: inline-block; width: 10px; height: 10px; margin-right: 10px; border-radius: 50%; background: #61D095; } .ds-theme-preview i:nth-of-type(2) { background: #E7B84B; } .ds-theme-preview i:nth-of-type(3) { background: #E6544D; } .ds-theme-preview:hover { border-color: #61D095; } .ds-theme-preview:focus-visible { outline: none; border: 2px solid #61D095; } .ds-theme-preview:active { background: #0D1518; }

narrative.overview:
Signal Cabin is Zara's native Linux operating shell: a precise route of status rails, open work fields, and grounded controls. Its charcoal enamel, warm type, and illuminated signals remain the default identity even as complete alternate themes reskin the same semantic component system.

Conversation and configuration share one grammar. Quick Copilot, Full Chat, and Settings expose real runtime or file state without generic AI-card chrome, decorative effects, or invented capability cues.
keyCharacteristics: One semantic component system across five complete themes.
Continuous route-divider transcripts and rail-based navigation.
One platform-standard composer action that changes from send to stop.
Open native forms, a real source editor, and a guided managed-fact rail.

rules.name: The Role, Not Hue Rule
rules.body: Components consume semantic roles, never theme-specific color literals; switching theme must reskin every open Zara surface without changing behavior or hierarchy.

rules.name: The Three-Gauge Rule
rules.body: Narrow type names the instrument, Adwaita carries human language, and mono reports or edits machine state.

rules.name: The Tonal Depth Rule
rules.body: Surfaces earn depth through semantic panel tone and precise lines, never blur, glass, glow, gradient, or drop shadow.

dos: Do resolve every component through the shared semantic roles in all five themes.
Do preserve visible contrast, primary focus borders, and accessible control names in every palette.
Do use Qt platform-standard icons for send and stop while keeping text labels in tooltips and accessibility metadata.
Do keep Settings as one category rail, one open task surface, and one truthful save/restart footer.
Do keep approved source and managed facts visibly connected to the real configuration path.
donts: Don't recolor only the accent while leaving panels, lines, text, or state feedback from another theme.
Don't add gradients, glass, ambient glow, drop shadows, or nested preference cards.
Don't use Unicode arrows, squares, or other text glyphs as UI icons.
Don't hide restart requirements, failed validation, restoration, or live-reload state behind generic success copy.
Don't break the continuous route transcript into generic assistant cards or bubbles.
